title: Google Chronicle

fields.name: customer_id
fields.description: The customer ID identifying the Google Chronicle tenant to stream into.

fields.name: google_service_credentials
fields.description: Absolute path to a Google Cloud credentials JSON file.

fields.name: log_key
fields.description: By default, the whole log record is sent to Google Chronicle.

fields.name: log_type
fields.description: The log type to parse logs as.

fields.name: project_id
fields.description: The project ID containing the Google Chronicle tenant to stream into.
fields.default: Value of the `project_id` in the credentials file

fields.name: region
fields.description: The GCP region in which to store security logs.

fields.name: service_account_email
fields.description: Account email associated with the service.

fields.name: service_account_secret
fields.description: Private key content associated with the service account.

fields.name: workers
fields.description: The number of [workers](/manual/administration/multithreading.md#outputs) to perform flush operations for this output.

fields.name: match
fields.description: Tag match pattern used to route records to this plugin. Supports '*' wildcard matching.

fields.name: match_regex
fields.description: Regular expression tag match used to route records to this plugin. Takes precedence over match when both are set.

description: The Google Chronicle output plugin lets you ingest security logs into the Google Chronicle service.
